text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Listen, it was amazing! The entire time I 
was running, the cheering never stopped!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
I heard everything! Everyone cheering, "Do 
your best, Urara-chan!"

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
And so, I tried super hard to pass the 
girl in front of me, to pass her no matter 
what!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
I ran! But, y'know, they were super fast, 
so I couldn't catch up at all!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
If only my legs were just a tiny bit 
longer, I know for sure I would've 
overtaken them!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Why am I crying? I had so, so much fun, 
too.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
"It was so much fun, and I just wanted to 
keep running forever and ever... *sniff*, 
but..."
choice_data_list: You gave it your all, Haru Urara!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
It was so fun...! It was super, duper 
fun~!

"Haru Urara, who ran with all her heart, 
may have finally learned what true 
frustration feels like. It is undeniable 
proof of her growth."

Afterward, I kept gently rubbing Haru 
Urara's back for a while until she calmed 
down...

And so, Haru Urara gave it everything she 
had running across the stage of her 
dreams!
